atomicity.reason: Calculation rule, message type and period are bundled; closely related facets of one obligation.
atomicity.suggestion: Optionally separate the calculation from the cyclic transmission.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained; terms are standard domain vocabulary.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the torque conversion and TSC1 transmission of ARCH_ENG_TORQUE_INTERFACE.

unambiguity.reason: Units are left open: P / n needs speed in rad/s (not rpm), and TSC1 carries torque as percent of reference torque, a conversion not stated.
unambiguity.suggestion: State units and the conversion to the TSC1 percent-of-reference-torque encoding.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/eng (diesel-only folder); its parent is gated the same (`not bev`) or ungated, so it never exists without its parent.

verifiability.reason: Value and 10 ms period are checkable on the J1939 bus.
